name: XCC_REV_FUND_RULE_BALANCES
description: This tables stores the budget balance funded from revenue by control budget, revenue funding rule and budget year.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget identifier of the accumulated funding balance.

columns.name: REV_FUND_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue funding rule identifier of the accumulated funding balance.

columns.name: BUDGET_PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Budget year of the control budget period derived from the calendar of the control budget.

columns.name: ACCUMULATED_FUNDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of funding from revenue added to the budget for the control budget, revenue funding rule and budget year.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
